assets.name: quiet apartment
assets.reference: Bird mark, as loose silhouette and color inspiration
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: polished editorial illustration for a premium air-conditioning care company's website hero, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024.
Create ONE beautifully composed, unified, warm narrative illustration, hand-painted by one illustrator. This is a lived-in Israeli apartment in late afternoon, interpreted through Japanese shin-hanga woodblock prints and contemporary gouache picture-book art. Not a website mockup. No lettering.
The hero is a faithful wall-mounted split air conditioner who has quietly worked all summer. He is mildly tired, patient and lovable, NOT sad, angry or sarcastic. A real rectangular ivory indoor unit with proper intake and lower louver, substantial volume, small curved sleepy eyelids and a tiny kind smile. Subtle character, no human nose, no eyebrows, no giant eyes. Very clearly an air conditioner rather than a rounded capsule.
Composition: an intimate medium-wide view of a cream plaster wall. The AC is the largest protagonist, upper-left/center, approximately 43% of the canvas width; easy to read at small scale. A smaller beautiful partly-open window is on the right, with generous clear wall between the appliance and window (at least one quarter of the AC width). The window is taller but narrower than the AC. Window with warm olive painted wooden frames, physically coherent perspective, thin pale linen curtain. Through it are Mediterranean white flat-roof homes, distant olive-green hills and a deep terracotta setting sun. A graceful small dark forest-green bird perches on the INNER sill and attentively turns toward the AC. It has convincing folded feathers, elegant sweeping tail, cream chest, delicate feet, a small crest matching the curved silhouette of the supplied bird logo reference. Bird is a companion, not dominant. No logo itself pasted into the illustration.
Unify all elements with confident hand-drawn dark green ink contours, beautiful restrained gouache shading, woodblock-style cloud and hill shapes, fine paper grain. The AC must be illustrated with the SAME confident line and color as the window and bird. Rich but disciplined colors: ivory/cream #F6F1E6, deep forest green #203D38, terracotta #B74A31, muted olive, soft warm ochre. A few atmospheric diagonal late-afternoon shadows establish ONE shared room. The background fades gently to FLAT #F6F1E6 around all outer edges so this illustration merges naturally with a cream website. No rectangular frame around the scene, no card border, no sticker cutouts. Clear visual hierarchy and airy but purposeful negative space. The wall is the background; do not draw full floor, furniture or an entire dollhouse.
Mood: quiet service, affection, home comfort. A little poetic, sophisticated, welcoming, not bleak or washed out.
Reference input: use ONLY the supplied image's bird silhouette/colors as loose inspiration for the perched bird, not the logo layout.
Avoid: isolated assets, clipart collage, vector diagram look, photoreal bird next to cartoon appliance, brown engraving, creepy doll eyes, pointed angry eyebrows, smirk, crying, sweat, dirt clouds, broad comic mouth, arms/legs on appliance, overly rounded pill unit, text, speech bubbles, labels, watermark.

assets.prompt:

1. Air conditioner: remove the two drawn eyelids and the little smiling mouth completely. Restore a continuous plain ivory painted front panel with the same existing gouache texture, natural lighting, shading and perspective.
